cases.title: “Ask about this” on the Mobile tile
cases.question: What has Brad built on mobile?
cases.answer: Brad has built a range of mobile work across several jobs. At Bleacher Report, Brad built and maintained Android product experiences for a high-traffic sports media platform, across architecture, feature delivery, reliability and release quality. At Bottle Rocket, Brad shipped native Android apps in Java and Kotlin for brands including Coca-Cola Freestyle, AskPETMD, Starwood SPG and Chewy. At BookShout, Brad modernized the Android app with Kotlin, Architecture Components, Data Binding, RxJava 2, OkHttp and Retrofit. At Hopper, Brad co-architected and built RemoteUI, a server-driven UI framework rendered natively with Jetpack Compose and MVVM on Android and SwiftUI on iOS, so UI changes ship to both platforms with server deploys instead of app releases. On the side, Brad is the founder and principal engineer of VINDecoded, a side project since May 2015. It is one product on three platforms. A React web app runs in the browser and inside both mobile apps. Native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (SwiftUI) shells add what the web can't do: Bluetooth to the car, store billing, ads and the camera.

cases.title: “Ask about this” on the Full-stack tile
cases.question: What has Brad built across the stack?
cases.answer: Brad has built across mobile, web, backend and AI work. On mobile, Brad built hopper.com features and partner portals for RBC, Lloyds Bank, Nubank and CommBank. On the web and in the back end, VINDecoded was re-platformed from AngularJS/Cordova to a React/TypeScript web app, native Android and iOS apps, and a Node.js/TypeScript API backed by SQL, Firebase, Azure and cloud analytics. Brad co-developed Scala services and partner API contracts for order confirmation, payment collection, contract creation and persistence, and servicing, including refunds and rebooking. On AI, Brad shipped production AI features: grounded streaming vehicle chat, with provider-switchable models and tool-isolated vehicle data, and vision-based VIN, plate and gas-receipt scanning with structured outputs.
